title: Cron callers can distinguish an impossible date from a distant leap day
summary: Both merged cron APIs returned no match for June 31 and found the leap day in 2104 after February 29, 2096. The old trigger threw for each search.

change.description: CronTrigger now computes future dates through the new java.time-based CronExpression. Existing Date callers can observe a null result for an impossible calendar date. The new API can also return a matching LocalDateTime or ZonedDateTime directly.

notes: A fixed TriggerContext and UTC keep the calendar independent of the clock. Both triggers selected June 30, 2021 for the ordinary control.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-context-5.3.0-M1. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
